decisions: Use bukak/tutup kurung biasa, kurung siku and kurung kurawal consistently to identify every delimiter type; Indonesian uses buka/tutup. These extend the existing operation lesson's explicit bracket naming.
Kurung siku and kurung kurawal retain declared Indonesian-derived school-label components. No newly standardized Javanese bracket terminology is claimed.
Read selikur and patlikur for source 21 and 24 using actual C18 evidence; wolu/sanga are supported by C26/C27. Other fixed small-number forms retain the preceding provisional narration convention.
Speak all five source-implied multiplication sites as ping/kali without inserting visible operators. Read division as dipara/dibagi and the binary U+2212 minus as dikurangi.

Use academic Ekspresi kapisan/kapindho/katelu and conversational Wujud siji/loro/telu only as auditory enumeration of the three source layout cells. Formula content remains identical in both Javanese registers.
